_about: Water v2 (docs/world/water-v2.md; read by sim/world/fill.gd): holes the fight digs fill with water where water would plausibly come from. enabled: the whole model (off: the water module is exactly as it was, gen 1 bit for bit). A hole opens a fill window when ground in the touched span is dug at least minDug below its original height; the window then fills each column toward its target level: the level of open water within near.reach columns (the sea at 0, a lake's flat surface, water already standing), for ground at most near.maxRise above it, and the biome's water table (table: the depth below the original ground the water stands at, 0 or missing for a dry biome; near: true if the table is there only with open water in reach). The fill is a cheap local rate, rate units of depth a step toward the target, behind a front that runs from the source at front columns a step (a seeping table has no front). A window is at most halfMax columns either side, at most maxWindows fills at once, closes after settle quiet steps or ageMax steps. It never trapping, lifting or slowing a fighter (Game Design 23b row 15) and does no damage (row 17). wade.below: water shallower than this is waded (a body passing through it is not dragged or sunk; it still skims). wave: a slam (impact energy at least minE) into water standing minDepth deep throws a ring wave that pushes anything within band of the surface and within radius units of the slam push units outward over steps steps. douse: a fill or wave that covers a column scorched at least scorchMin puts the fire out (an event for the steam; the sim keeps no fire).
